Root cause diagnosed (not acted on, since instructed not to modify after seeing results): S&P 500 buy-and-hold returned +11.69%/yr over the test window and the z-score split is ~51/49 long/short, so the symmetric short leg structurally fights a strong secular equity drift roughly half the time - likely swamping the genuine but small Gate-1 correlation. REJECTED as a standalone edge. The underlying positioning phenomenon may still be real (Gate 1 evidence is genuine) - a future FRESH pre-registration (e.g. long-only conviction-weighted, not symmetric long/short) could test that, but this is not a modification of E19, it would be a new edge_id if pursued.
